title: mapping calls and unmapped criteria counted offline, each record kept to its study

findings.claim: tools.public_accuracy.rerun's default ReplayModel answers concept_map calls from every study's stored replies (Stored.concept and concept_loose are not keyed by job), and its loose match takes an empty answer for any candidate list; the H-26 compile report's re-compile used it, so a study's re-compiled concept_unmapped count can rest on another study's answer (not re-measured here)

The card's proof on P2b sigir (676 concept_map calls, 416 criteria flagged concept_unmapped) cannot be run from the tree: the archives are on the unmerged branch integrator/p2b-artefacts; the in-tree public slice holds 23 concept_map calls of launch P1b
